business_problem: When preserving and creating wealth for our clients, it’s essential to establish a personal connection. That is the only way the client will trust the advisor, and the advisor can understand the client’s needs.
solution_summary: When preserving and creating wealth for our clients, it’s essential to establish a personal connection. That is the only way the client will trust the advisor, and the advisor can understand the client’s needs. This is particularly true when it comes to financials. Van Lanschot Kempen is one of the world’s oldest financial institutions still existing. This Netherlands-based firm has the experience to know just how important the personal touch is in its business, which is why it always strives to give its employees time to build personal connections with colleagues and clients. Thanks to Copilot for Microsoft 365, Van Lanschot Kempen is reducing the time needed for daily tasks, freeing up time to invest in that crucial personal connection. The challenge: Unautomated day-to-day tasks take up a lot of time
